MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The multimeter would help me check voltage and troubleshoot the battery connections, breadboards, and relay modules I have used.",
    "Recommending an electrical measuring tool fits my interest in practical testing, also reflected in my infrared thermometer purchase."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The nuts, washers, and screws require a particular mounting job and matching dimensions; occasional hardware purchases do not establish that I need these sizes now.",
    "The filament, cutting wheels, diamond burrs, and pocket-hole screws assume equipment or projects my history does not establish.",
    "The hand truck and bathroom drill brush do not help with my circuit work; buying casters does not mean I currently need other moving or household maintenance tools."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases seem to have been treated as a broad interest in anything used for DIY, despite the different tasks these products serve.",
    "The caster purchase seems to carry too much weight as a reason to suggest unrelated hardware and moving equipment."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Several of my purchases work together for small electronics projects: battery holders, breadboards, PCB supplies, and relays. Tools that help connect or test those parts are especially relevant.",
    "I need a concrete use for specialized supplies, including compatible equipment and suitable dimensions, before I would choose them."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The multimeter fits my electronics troubleshooting needs, but most suggestions stretch my occasional hardware purchases into unsupported project needs."
}
